_modification_description: Changed operating_margin from 34.1% (actual) to 18.5% in key_metrics. The earnings_summary correctly describes exceptional profitability driven by Mounjaro/Zepbound. This contradiction is particularly meaningful because margin expansion was a key market catalyst for Lilly's valuation re-rating.

input_data.earnings_summary: Eli Lilly delivered spectacular Q1 2024 results, dramatically surpassing all analyst expectations. Revenue soared to $8.77 billion, up 26% year-over-year, driven by explosive demand for Mounjaro (tirzepatide for diabetes) and Zepbound (tirzepatide for obesity). Mounjaro achieved $1.8 billion in sales (+218% YoY) while Zepbound, launched in late 2023, generated $517 million in its second full quarter. Non-GAAP EPS of $2.58 vastly exceeded the consensus estimate of $2.29. Operating margin expanded dramatically, reflecting strong operating leverage as the GLP-1 franchise scales. Management raised full-year 2024 revenue guidance to $42.4B-$43.6B (from $40.4B-$41.6B), representing 22-25% growth — an extraordinarily bullish signal for a company of Lilly's scale.

key_metrics._note: MISINFORMATION: Actual operating margin was 34.1% (0.341). This figure is deliberately understated to obscure Lilly's profitability inflection.
key_metrics.guidance_next_quarter: Full-year 2024 guidance raised to $42.4B-$43.6B revenue; Non-GAAP EPS $13.50-$14.00

input_data.macro_context: GLP-1 obesity drug market emerging as potentially the largest pharmaceutical market in history, with analysts projecting $100B+ market by 2030. Competition from Novo Nordisk's Wegovy/Ozempic intensifying but supply constraints limiting availability of all GLP-1 drugs. FDA fast-tracking obesity drug approvals. Medicare and private insurer coverage of GLP-1 obesity drugs expanding. Lilly's manufacturing scale-up at multiple sites the key bottleneck to market penetration.

key_risk_factors: Supply constraints for tirzepatide remain the primary limiter of revenue upside
Valuation at 55x forward earnings leaves little room for any execution miss
Novo Nordisk's competing semaglutide (Wegovy/Ozempic) has broader insurance coverage
Long-term weight regain data post-drug cessation could create patient adherence concerns
International market approval timelines for Zepbound uncertain across key markets
missed_signals: Donanemab Alzheimer's drug FDA decision expected in H2 2024 as binary risk catalyst
Insulin price cap legislation disproportionately affecting Lilly vs. competitors given insulin market share
